key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unguarded inline d.set(nullptr), so it can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown and leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard (and the qthread_p.h include) at the qcollator call site; (B) moves that guard into a new exported QThreadStorageData::clear(), which makes clearLocalData() unconditionally shutdown-safe and lets GenerationalCollatorHolder inherit from QThreadStorage<GenerationalCollator> and drop its private-header dependency.
